items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I played with George and Wilde, you see.

ctx.x: Well at the time, see I don't know whether he was managing the band at the time, that he talked to me or not, but he had something to do with it I know. But he was the original Sonny South. He died too.
I see, but they had another guitar player in there when you were with the Sonny South. Yeah, Richard McLean. No, I played with George and Wilde, you see.
